sterGlobalOption(self, {
                    Id = nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish,
                    NameSpanish = textSpanish,
                    NameEnglish = textEnglish,
                    Holder = Holder,
                    Kind = "Toggle",
                })
            end

            return {
                SetValue = function(value)
                    state = value
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.3)
                    applyVisual(state, true)
                end,
                GetValue = function()
                    return state
                end,
                Holder = Holder,
                Switch = Switch,
                Click = Click
            }
        end

        function Tab:CreateDropdown(textSpanish, textEnglish, options, default, callback)
            options = options or {}
            local displayText = GetText(textSpanish, textEnglish)
            local selected = default

            local function selectedDisplay()
                return selected or GetText("Elegí una opción", "Pick an option")
            end

            local Holder = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = TabPage,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.78,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
            Holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(Holder, 10)
            stroke(Holder, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.55)

            local AccentBar = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 36),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -18),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            AccentBar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
            corner(AccentBar, 999)

            local LabelTxt = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 22),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 13),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = displayText,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 15,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", textSpanish)
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", textEnglish)

            local StateLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 16),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 36),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = selectedDisplay(),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 11,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            StateLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")

            local ChevronBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0.5, -20),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                Text = "v",
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 16,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            ChevronBtn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
            corner(ChevronBtn, 999)

            resetScrollTop(TabPage)

            local function buildPopupContents(Popup, closePopup)
                for _, optionValue in ipairs(options) do
                    local Row = mk("TextButton", {
                        Parent = Popup,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
                        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                        BackgroundTransparency = (optionValue == selected) and 0.4 or 0.78,
                        Text = "",
                        ZIndex = 203
                    })
                    Row:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
                    corner(Row, 6)

                    local RowLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = Row,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = optionValue,
                        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                        TextSize = 12,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                        ZIndex = 204
                    })
                    RowLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")

                    Row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        selected = optionValue
                        StateLabel.Text = selectedDisplay()
                        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                        closePopup()
                        pcall(callback, selected)
                    end)
                end
            end

            attachDropdownBehavior(Holder, ChevronBtn, ChevronBtn, #options, buildPopupContents)

            if Window._RegisterGlobalOption then
                Window._RegisterGlobalOption(self, {
                    Id = nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish,
                    NameSpanish = textSpanish,
                    NameEnglish = textEnglish,
                    Holder = Holder,
                    Kind = "Dropdown",
                })
            end

            return {
                SetValue = function(value)
                    selected = value
                    StateLabel.Text = selectedDisplay()
                end,
                GetValue = function()
                    return selected
                end,
                Holder = Holder,
                Click = ChevronBtn
            }
        end

        function Tab:CreateFloatingToggleSimple(text, default, callback)
            local state = default or false
            local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
            
            local FloatingWindow = mk("Frame", {
                Name = "FloatingToggleSimple_" .. text,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 50),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.1, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 150,
                CanQuery = true,
                Active = true,
                Selectable = false,
            }, Window.ScreenGui)
            FloatingWindow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            
            corner(FloatingWindow, 999)
            
            stroke(FloatingWindow, Theme.Accent, 2, 0.5)
            buildAnimatedBorder(FloatingWindow, Theme.Border, UDim.new(1, 0), true)
            
            local TextContainer = mk("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 151
            }, FloatingWindow)
            
            local NameLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = text,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 14,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                ZIndex = 151
            }, TextContainer)
            NameLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            
            local StateLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Size = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = state and "ON" or "OFF",
                TextColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 14,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                ZIndex = 151
            }, TextContainer)
            StateLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "TextDim")
            
            local shimmerGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            shimmerGradient.Rotation = 90
            shimmerGradient.ColorSequence = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.9),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.9)
            })
            shimmerGradient.Parent = FloatingWindow
            
            local shimmerTween = TweenService:Create(
                shimmerGradient,
                TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true, 0),
                {Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)}
            )
            shimmerTween:Play()
            track(shimmerTween)
            
            local originalSize = FloatingWindow.Size
            local pulseSize = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 55)
            
            local pulseTween = TweenService:Create(
                FloatingWindow,
                TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true, 0),
                {Size = pulseSize}
            )
            pulseTween:Play()
            track(pulseTween)
            
            local ClickDetector = mk("TextButton", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                Active = true,
                Selectable = false,
                ZIndex = 152
            }, FloatingWindow)
            
            local isDragging = false
            local dragStart = nil
            local dragStartPos = nil
            local isHovering = false

            local function clampSimpleFloatingWindow()
                if not FloatingWindow or not FloatingWindow.Parent then return end
                local viewport = Window.ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize
                local windowSize = FloatingWindow.AbsoluteSize
                if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 or windowSize.X <= 0 or windowSize.Y <= 0 then return end

                local margin = 8
                local pos = FloatingWindow.Position
                local minX = margin - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                local maxX = viewport.X - windowSize.X - margin - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                local minY = margin - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y
                local maxY = viewport.Y - windowSize.Y - margin - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y
                local x = maxX < minX and ((viewport.X - windowSize.X) / 2) - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                    or math.clamp(pos.X.Offset, minX, maxX)
                local y = maxY < minY and ((viewport.Y - windowSize.Y) / 2) - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y
                    or math.clamp(pos.Y.Offset, minY, maxY)

                if x ~= pos.X.Offset or y ~= pos.Y.Offset then
                    FloatingWindow.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, x, pos.Y.Scale, y)
                end
            end
            clampSimpleFloatingWindow()
            track(FloatingWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(clampSimpleFloatingWindow))
            track(Window.ScreenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(clampSimpleFloatingWindow))
            
            local function updateState()
                if state then
                    StateLabel.Text = "ON"
                    StateLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.ToggleOn
                else
                    StateLabel.Text = "OFF"
                    StateLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim
                end
                StateLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "TextDim")
            end
            
            track(FloatingWindow.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                isHovering = true
                TweenService:Create(
                    FloatingWindow,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = 0.15}
                ):Play()
            end))
            
            track(FloatingWindow.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                isHovering = false
                TweenService:Create(
                    FloatingWindow,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = 0.3}
                ):Play()
            end))
            
            track(ClickDetector.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                state = not state
                updateState()
                
                pcall(function() playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6) end)
                
                local pressSize = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 45)
                TweenService:Create(
                    FloatingWindow,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                    {Size = pressSize, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5}
                ):Play()
                
                task.wait(0.08)
                
                TweenService:Create(
                    FloatingWindow,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Size = originalSize, BackgroundTransparency = isHovering and 0.15 or 0.3}
                ):Play()
                
                if callback then
                    pcall(function() callback(state) end)
                end
                
                print("[" .. text .. "] " .. (state and " ACTIVADO" or " DESACTIVADO"))
            end))
            
            track(ClickDetector.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    isDragging = true
                    dragStart = input.Position
                    dragStartPos = FloatingWindow.Position
                end
            end))
            
            track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                        FloatingWindow.Position = UDim2.new(
                            dragStartPos.X.Scale,
                            dragStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                            dragStartPos.Y.Scale,
                            dragStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                        )
                        clampSimpleFloatingWindow()
                end
            end))
            
            track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    isDragging = false
                end
            end))
            
            table.insert(Window.FloatingToggles, {Window = FloatingWindow, Name = text})

            Window._RegisterGlobalOption(self, {
                Id = text,
                NameSpanish = text,
                NameEnglish = text,
                Holder = FloatingWindow,
                Kind = "Floating",
            })

            return FloatingWindow
        end

        function Tab:CreateFloatingButton(textSpanish, textEnglishOrCooldown, cooldownOrCallback, callback, isMirror, mirrorSource)
            local textEnglish = textSpanish
            local cooldown, cb

            if type(textEnglishOrCooldown) == "string" then
                textEnglish = textEnglishOrCooldown
                if type(cooldownOrCallback) == "number" then
                    cooldown = cooldownOrCallback
                    cb = callback
                else
                    cooldown = 0
                    cb = cooldownOrCallback
                end
            elseif type(textEnglishOrCooldown) == "number" then
                cooldown = textEnglishOrCooldown
                cb = cooldownOrCallback
            else
                cooldown = 0
                cb = textEnglishOrCooldown
            end
            cooldown = cooldown or 0

            local displayText = GetText(textSpanish, textEnglish)
            local isFloating  = false
            local isLocked    = false
            local onCooldown  = false

            local FloatingWindow = nil
            local FloatingGlow   = nil
            local FloatLabel     = nil
            local AccentBar      = nil
            local StateLabel     = nil
            local favoriteControlRefreshers = {}
            local toggleFloating
            local toggleLock

            local function startCooldown()
                if cooldown <= 0 then return end
                onCooldown = true
                AccentBar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TextDim
                pcall(function()
                    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
                    bar.Name = "CooldownBar"
                    bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
                    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -4)
                    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 3)
                    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
                    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    bar.ZIndex = 11
                    local bc = Instance.new("UICorner")
                    bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
                    bc.Parent = bar
                    bar.Parent = AccentBar.Parent
                    local tw = TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(cooldown, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3)})
                    tw.Completed:Connect(function() bar:Destroy() end)
                    tw:Play()
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local remaining = cooldown
                    while remaining > 0 do
                        task.wait(0.1)
                        remaining = math.max(0, remaining - 0.1)
                        local cdTxt = string.format("%.1fs", remaining)
                        StateLabel.Text = cdTxt
                        if FloatLabel and FloatLabel.Parent then
                            FloatLabel.Text      = cdTxt
                            FloatLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
                        end
                    end
                    onCooldown = false
                    AccentBar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
                    StateLabel.Text = GetText("Botón", "Button")
                    if FloatLabel and FloatLabel.Parent then
                        FloatLabel.Text = displayText
                        TweenService:Create(FloatLabel, TweenInfo.new(0.20), {TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}):Play()
                    end
                end)
            end

            local Holder = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = TabPage,
                Size   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.78,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
            Holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(Holder, 10)
            local HolderStroke = stroke(Holder, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.55)
            RowKit.Card(Holder)

            AccentBar = mk("Frame", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 36),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -18),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                ZIndex   = 10
            })
            AccentBar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            corner(AccentBar, 999)

            local LabelTxt = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 22),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 13),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text     = displayText,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font     = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 15,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate   = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex   = 10
            })
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("TextSpanish",  textSpanish)
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("TextEnglish",  textEnglish)

            StateLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 16),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 36),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text     = GetText("Botón", "Button"),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font     = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 11,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                ZIndex   = 10
            })
            StateLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
            RowKit.Chip(StateLabel, "Accent")
            StateLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 38)

            local DetachBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.5, -14),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                Text     = "↗",
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                Font     = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 13,
                ZIndex   = 15
            })
            corner(DetachBtn, 6)
            RowKit.Control(DetachBtn, true)

            local PinBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, -14),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                Image    = "rbxassetid://83537941312438",
                ImageColor3 = Theme.Text,
                ScaleType   = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
                ZIndex   = 15
            })
            corner(PinBtn, 6)
            stroke(PinBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
            RowKit.Control(PinBtn)

            local function syncExternalState()
                if not isMirror or not mirrorSource then return end
                local floating = false
                local locked = false
                pcall(function() floating = mirrorSource.GetFloating() end)
                pcall(function() locked = mirrorSource.GetLocked() end)
                DetachBtn.Text = floating and "←" or "↗"
                PinBtn.Image = locked and "rbxassetid://91959170037380" or "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
            end
            syncExternalState()

            if not isMirror then
                local favId = nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish
                local isFavorite = SavedFavoriteIds[favId] or false
                local FavBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                    Parent = Holder,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0.5, -15),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = isFavorite and "rbxassetid://113655648685815" or "rbxassetid://90877976276431",
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    ZIndex = 15
                })

                local favRow = nil
                local function syncFavoriteRow()
                    favoriteControlRefreshers = {}
                    if favRow then
                        pcall(function() favRow.Holder:Destroy() end)
                        favRow = nil
                    end
                    if isFavorite and AutoTabFavoritosRef then
                        favRow = AutoTabFavoritosRef:CreateFloatingButton(
                            textSpanish, textEnglish, cooldown, cb, true,
                            {
                                ToggleFloating = function() toggleFloating() end,
                                ToggleLock = function() toggleLock() end,
                                GetFloating = function() return isFloating end,
                                GetLocked = function() return isLocked end,
                            }
                        )
                        if favRow.SyncExternalState then
                            table.insert(favoriteControlRefreshers, favRow.SyncExternalState)
                        end
                    end
                end
                FavBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    isFavorite = not isFavorite
                    FavBtn.Image = isFavorite and "rbxassetid://113655648685815" or "rbxassetid://90877976276431"
                    SavedFavoriteIds[favId] = isFavorite or nil
                    syncFavoriteRow()
                    SyncFavoritesToConfig()
                end)

                syncFavoriteRow()
            end

            local HolderClick = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(1, isMirror and -100 or -120, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text     = "",
                ZIndex   = 13
            })

            HolderClick.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(Holder, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = RowKit.HOVER}):Play()
            end)
            HolderClick.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(Holder, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = RowKit.IDLE}):Play()
            end)

            HolderClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if onCooldown then return end
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                RowKit.Press(Holder)
                HolderStroke.Color = Theme.Accent
                HolderStroke.Transparency = 0.1
                TweenService:Create(HolderStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.45), {Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.55}):Play()
                pcall(cb)
                startCooldown()
            end)

            local function createFloatingWindow()
                FloatingGlow = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent   = Window.ScreenGui,
                    Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(216, 48),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -108, 0.5, -24),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex  = 3
                })
                corner(FloatingGlow, 999)

                local pillW = math.max(120, FloatingPillV5.FitWidth(displayText, 20))
                FloatingWindow = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent   = Window.ScreenGui,
                    Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(pillW, 34),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -pillW / 2, 0.5, -17),
                    BackgroundColor3 = FloatingPillV5.OffColor(),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Active = true,
                    Selectable = false,
                    ZIndex  = 4
                })
                FloatPos.Apply(nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, FloatingWindow)
                if FloatPos.IsLocked(nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish) then
                    isLocked = true
                    PinBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://91959170037380"
                end
                corner(FloatingWindow, 999)
                local pillStroke = stroke(FloatingWindow, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 2, 0.15)
                pillStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", nil)
                mk("UIGradient", {
                    Rotation = 90,
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.35),
                    }),
                }, FloatingWindow)
                local pillScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, FloatingWindow)

                FloatLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent   = FloatingWindow,
                    Name     = "FloatLabel",
                    Size     = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text     = onCooldown and StateLabel.Text or displayText,
                    TextColor3 = onCooldown and Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                    Font     = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                    TextSize = 20,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                    TextTruncate   = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    ZIndex   = 5,
                })
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish",  textSpanish)
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish",  textEnglish)

                local function flashBtn()
                    pillScale.Scale = 0.9
                    TweenService:Create(pillScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(FloatingWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.08),
                        {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(pillStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
                    task.delay(0.22, function()
                        if FloatingWindow and FloatingWindow.Parent then
                            TweenService:Create(FloatingWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.25),
                                {BackgroundColor3 = FloatingPillV5.OffColor(), BackgroundTransparency = 0.12}):Play()
                            TweenService:Create(pillStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0.15}):Play()
                        end
                    end)
                    if cooldown > 0 then
                        local fill = mk("Frame", {
                            Parent = FloatingWindow,
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                            BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
                            BorderSizePixel = 0,
                            ZIndex = 4,
                        })
                        corner(fill, 999)
                        local tw = TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(cooldown, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)})
                        tw.Completed:Connect(function() fill:Destroy() end)
                        tw:Play()
                    end
                end

                local dragging  = false
                local dragStart = nil
                local startPos  = nil

                local FloatClick = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent   = FloatingWindow,
                    Size     = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = "",
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Active = true,
                    Selectable = false,
                    ZIndex   = 6
                })

                FloatClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if dragging or onCooldown then return end
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    flashBtn()
                    pcall(cb)
                    startCooldown()
                end)

                local function syncGlow()
                    if FloatingGlow and FloatingGlow.Parent then
                        FloatingGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
                            FloatingWindow.Size.X.Offset + 16,
                            FloatingWindow.Size.Y.Offset + 12)
                        FloatingGlow.Position = UDim2.new(
                            FloatingWindow.Position.X.Scale,
                            FloatingWindow.Position.X.Offset - 8,
                            FloatingWindow.Position.Y.Scale,
                            FloatingWindow.Position.Y.Offset - 6)
                    end
                end
                syncGlow()
                track(FloatingWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(syncGlow))

                FloatClick.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or  input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
                    and not isLocked then
                        dragging  = false
                        dragStart = input.Position
                        startPos  = FloatingWindow.Position
                    end
                end)

                track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if dragStart and not isLocked
                    and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                    or   input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                        if delta.Magnitude > 4 then
                            dragging = true
                            FloatingWindow.Position = UDim2.new(
                                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                        end
                    end
                end))

                track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        task.defer(function() dragging = false end)
                        dragStart = nil
                    end
                end))

                table.insert(Window.FloatingToggles, {Window = FloatingWindow, Name = displayText})
            end

            toggleFloating = function()
                if isMirror and mirrorSource then
                    pcall(mirrorSource.ToggleFloating)
                    syncExternalState()
                    return
                end
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
                if not isFloating then
                    isFloating = true
                    createFloatingWindow()
                    DetachBtn.Text = "←"
                else
                    isFloating   = false
                    FloatLabel   = nil
                    if FloatingWindow then FloatingWindow:Destroy(); FloatingWindow = nil end
                    if FloatingGlow   then FloatingGlow:Destroy();   FloatingGlow   = nil end
                    DetachBtn.Text = "↗"
                    isLocked   = false
                    PinBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
                end
                for _, refresh in ipairs(favoriteControlRefreshers) do pcall(refresh) end
            end

            toggleLock = function()
                if isMirror and mirrorSource then
                    pcall(mirrorSource.ToggleLock)
                    syncExternalState()
                    return
                end
                if not isFloating then return end
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                isLocked = not isLocked
                if isLocked then FloatPos.Save(nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, FloatingWindow, Window.ScreenGui) else FloatPos.SetLocked(nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, false) end
                PinBtn.Image = isLocked
                    and "rbxassetid://91959170037380"
                    or  "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
                for _, refresh in ipairs(favoriteControlRefreshers) do pcall(refresh) end
            end

            DetachBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFloating)
            PinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleLock)

            resetScrollTop(TabPage)

            if not isMirror then
                Window._RegisterGlobalOption(self, {
                    Id = nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish,
                    NameSpanish = textSpanish,
                    NameEnglish = textEnglish,
                    Holder = Holder,
                    Kind = "Button",
                })
            end

            return {
                Holder = Holder,
                Fire = function()
                    if not onCooldown then
                        pcall(cb)
                        startCooldown()
                    end
                end,
                SetCooldown = function(secs)
                    cooldown = secs or cooldown
                end,
                SyncExternalState = syncExternalState,
            }
        end

        function Tab:CreateSlider(text, min, max, default, callback, isMirror)
            local value = default or min
            local pendingValue = value
            local isDragging = false
            local lastUpdateTime = 0
            local UPDATE_THROTTLE = 0.008

            local Carousel = nil
            local children = TabPage:GetChildren()
            for i = #children, 1, -1 do
                local child = children[i]
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    if child:GetAttribute("IsSliderCarouselSection") and Tab._LastSliderCarousel
                    and Tab._LastSliderCarousel.Section == child then
                        Carousel = Tab._LastSliderCarousel
                    end
                    break
                end
            end

            if not Carousel then
                local SliderSection = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = TabPage,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 134),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 9
                })
                SliderSection:SetAttribute("IsSliderCarouselSection", true)

                local Viewport = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = SliderSection,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 110),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ClipsDescendants = true,
                    ZIndex = 10
                })

                local PrevBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = Viewport,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, -19),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Text = "‹",
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    TextSize = 30,
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    ZIndex = 60
                })
                corner(PrevBtn, 19)
                stroke(PrevBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)

                local NextBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = Viewport,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0.5, -19),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Text = "›",
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    TextSize = 30,
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    ZIndex = 60
                })
                corner(NextBtn, 19)
                stroke(NextBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)

                local DotHolder = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = SliderSection,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 16),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 114),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 60
                })
                mk("UIListLayout", {
                    Parent = DotHolder,
                    FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                    HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
                    VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                    Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
                    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
                })

                Carousel = {
                    Section = SliderSection,
                    Viewport = Viewport,
                    PrevBtn = PrevBtn,
                    NextBtn = NextBtn,
                    DotHolder = DotHolder,
                    Cards = {},
                    Dots = {},
                    ActiveIndex = 1,
                    Reflow = nil,
                    GoTo = nil,
                }
                Tab._LastSliderCarousel = Carousel

                local function refreshDots()
                    local count = #Carousel.Cards
                    for i, dot in ipairs(Carousel.Dots) do
                        dot.BackgroundColor3 = (i == Carousel.ActiveIndex) and Theme.Text or Theme.AccentOff
                        dot.BackgroundTransparency = (i == Carousel.ActiveIndex) and 0 or 0.35
                        dot.Size = (i == Carousel.ActiveIndex)
                            and UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 7)
                            or UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7)
                    end
                    Carousel.PrevBtn.Visible = count > 1
                    Carousel.NextBtn.Visible = count > 1
                    Carousel.DotHolder.Visible = count > 1
                end

                local function reflow()
                    local count = #Carousel.Cards
                    if count == 0 then
                        refreshDots()
                        return
                    end

                    local viewportWidth = Carousel.Viewport.AbsoluteSize.X
                    local cardWidth = math.clamp(viewportWidth * 0.52, 240, 320)
                    local cardHeight = 96
                    local step = cardWidth * 0.78
                    local centerX = viewportWidth * 0.5 - cardWidth * 0.5

                    for i, cardData in ipairs(Carousel.Cards) do
                        local card = cardData.Holder
                        if card and card.Parent then
                            local offset = (i - Carousel.ActiveIndex) * step
                            local distance = math.abs(i - Carousel.ActiveIndex)
                            local targetX = centerX + offset
                            local targetWidth = distance == 0 and cardWidth or cardWidth * 0.86
                            local targetHeight = distance == 0 and cardHeight or cardHeight * 0.90
                            local targetY = 4 + (cardHeight - targetHeight) * 0.5
                            local isActive = distance == 0

                            TweenService:Create(
                                card,
                                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                                {
                                    Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX, 0, targetY),
                                    Size = UDim2.new(0, targetWidth, 0, targetHeight),
                                    BackgroundTransparency = isActive and 0.12 or 0.72
                                }
                            ):Play()
                            card.ZIndex = isActive and 50 or 20 - math.min(distance, 4)
                            for _, descendant in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
                                if descendant:IsA("GuiObject") then
                                    descendant.Z
